# IKEA ASM

Multi-view furniture assembly videos reused for action anticipation.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Furniture assembly observations preceding the next action.

**Output / label:** The next atomic assembly action in the specified anticipation subset.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/IkeaASM/IKEA_ASM_Dataset)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://github.com/IkeaASM/IKEA_ASM_Dataset), [anticipation_paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02846)

## Intention in this dataset

Predict a subsequent assembly action before onset using the cited anticipation protocol. The original atomic-action annotations are not direct mental-state labels.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2021

**Domains:** human_object_interaction, industrial_collaboration  
**Intention types:** action, task_goal  
**Tasks:** action_anticipation  
**Modalities:** rgb, depth, pose, object_state  
**Formats:** video, structured_annotation
